557:t_043:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even if that starting point, in my eyes, was the lowest sort of thug's trade」

557:t_043:9.en:
$$ベック$$
「Now I'm pissed! A minute ago I was thinking about what to do with my life, but that can wait!」

557:t_043:10.en:
$$ベック$$
「First I'm going to smash you! What comes next comes after that!」

557:t_043:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Very well. Then, for the sake of your rehabilitation, I shall deliberately indulge your way of doing things.」

557:t_043:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now, come at me! I'll face you with the full power of $$ビッグオー$$!」

557:t_043:13.en:
$$ベック$$
「Dammit! Same as always, you're all fired up, aren't you!」

557:t_044:0.en:
$$ベック$$
「Damn it! I can't take this anymore!」

557:t_044:2.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「You can't take it anymore... What are we going to do!?」

557:t_044:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「I'll think about that later! For now, we're getting out of here!」

557:t_044:5.en:
$$ベック$$
「Take care, $$ロジャー$$! If our paths cross, let's meet again!」

557:t_044:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「Though when we do, I'll beat you to a pulp!」

557:t_045:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...For now, this should cut him off from $$アマルガム$$.」

557:t_045:1.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「You care about him more than I expected.」

557:t_045:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A Negotiator and a thug... Oil and water, it seems, but he and I both come from $$パラダイムシティ$$.」

557:t_045:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I have no intention of becoming his friend, but the fact remains that he is someone who weighs on my mind.」

557:t_045:4.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Do as you like. I'm used to your contrariness.」

557:t_045:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Not that I want to see him badly enough to chase after him, mind you.」

557:t_046:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Of course! I've got a grudge against that guy!」

557:t_047:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
(The Tenth Angel... That was an enemy $$シンジ$$ has bitter memories of, wasn't it?)

557:t_048:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even with prior combat experience against it, to defeat an Angel in a single blow...」

557:t_048:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We grow every day as well. This can be called the strength of humanity.」

557:t_048:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「No act that would halt that progress can be permitted.」

557:t_048:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Are you watching, $$レナード$$? We cannot afford to lose to you, who cling to the past.)

557:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$千鳥$$... This time, I will rescue you for certain.)

557:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't care about $$レナード$$, or $$ソフィア$$, or the Major...! To get you back, I'll use any means necessary!)

557:t_101:0.en:
$$ベック$$
「What a grand stage! I'm going to settle everything right here, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!」

557:t_101:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「My apologies, $$ベック$$. Unlike an idler such as yourself, my schedule after this is packed as well.」

557:t_101:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Therefore, I'll be finishing with you quickly!」

557:t_101:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「You bastard! Right to the very end, you keep pissing me off!」

557:t_101:4.en:
$$ベック$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$! You really are the most infuriating bastard in the world!」

557:t_101:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Hearing that from you doesn't hurt me in the least.」

557:t_102:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(There's no $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ here, and no Father... But that Angel that made $$アスカ$$ and $$綾波$$ suffer, I'll take it down with my own hands...!)

557:t_103:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(The Spear... The power to redo the world...)

557:t_103:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(But I won't think about that now... I'll fight for what I can do in this world.)

557:t_104:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know. I know that your battles have been days of suffering and sorrow.」

557:t_104:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you only wish it, I'll invite you to a world where even the friend who died in an explosion is alive.」

557:t_104:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「My dad used to say... People can't go back to the past, so they live the present as hard as they can and try to make the future better...!」

557:t_104:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Like hell I'll fall for the words of a guy like you, who runs from his own suffering and sorrow and tries to have a good time all by himself!」

557:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Rewriting the past, huh... I can't tell if you're a positive thinker or a negative one...」

557:t_105:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Are you trying to provoke me?」

557:t_105:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I have no intention of exchanging words with you. Because I hold you in contempt and pity you at the same time.」

557:t_105:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「I won't let someone who can't find hope in the future have their way with this world!」

557:t_105:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun will rise again! I have no intention of listening to the words of someone who can't believe that!」

557:t_106:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you only wish it, I could even prepare a world where your company has become a major corporation.」

557:t_106:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, this guy! He's making fun of how $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ is always hovering on the edge of the red!」

557:t_106:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Nice try! That doesn't bother me... not one bit!」

557:t_106:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Ignoring the bottom line if it means helping people, is it... The employees stuck with a manager like you are unfortunate.」

557:t_106:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't decide that on your own! We're a small company now, but from here on we're going to keep growing bigger and bigger!」

557:t_106:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's why I'll protect the future of this world! That's my duty as President!!」

557:t_107:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「No father, no mother, a life spent fighting criminals... Doesn't it feel empty to you?」

557:t_107:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I imagine it does... But I can save you from your sorrow.」

557:t_107:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Because what makes me sad is that there are people suffering thanks to selfish people like you!」

557:t_107:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$'s power exists for the sake of peace! With that power, I will fight people like you!」

557:t_108:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「I've cornered you, villain! Your ambitions end right here!」

557:t_108:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「You don't seem able to understand what I'm thinking.」

557:t_108:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Like I give a damn about your world-fixing!」

557:t_108:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「What I can't forgive is that you attacked my school and made my buddy and his girlfriend suffer!!」

557:t_109:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come on, coward. I'll beat that rotten-to-the-core attitude out of you.」

557:t_109:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Do you sneer at what I'm doing as pathetic?」

557:t_109:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If you're pissed off, come at me. I'll crush your ambitions, along with that machine you're so proud of.」

557:t_109:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「As a member of the $$陣代高校$$ staff, I'll settle accounts with you right here!」

557:t_110:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「You, who lost your family... your beloved brother... I would think you could understand how I feel.」

557:t_110:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$マーグ$$'s death is in the past, too. I learned from $$マーグ$$ that you can't move forward into the future while trapped in the past.」

557:t_110:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「I won't hand a world that is trying to move on to the future over to you, who are trying to go back to the past!」

557:t_111:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's not that I don't understand how you feel...! But what's the point of doing something like that!」

557:t_111:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「There is a point. The world will be able to walk the right path with this.」
